suggestions.quote: Since this morning, a card opens over anyone who hears your good news. You've told no one all day.
suggestions.fix: Clarify how you discovered the power: “The cards started this morning, when you said a mock score out loud. Since four, you’ve told no one about this letter.”

suggestions.quote: The rival has never once thought about you. Your best friend has the next desk, the same chocolate bar, the same exam.
suggestions.fix: Resolve the contradiction with his two years of daily trash-talk: “The rival trash-talks whoever is nearest; you are just there. Your best friend has the next desk, the same chocolate bar, the same exam.”

suggestions.quote: At the 1992 Olympics, bronze medallists looked happier than silver (c08). Silver thinks of the gold it nearly won. Bronze thinks of nearly winning nothing (c08).
suggestions.fix: Cut this explanation from the emotional peak; the old letter and the following line already reveal the life your sister nearly had.

keep.quote: You got the place you wanted. And lost the one beside it.
She was never outside your lane. She was in it first.
That half-second is the other life, going past.
